correctness.rationale: For t<2, an exact facet sign count yields N=4+2I(y<(t-1)x)+2I(z<(t-1)x)+2I(z>(t-1)y). For t>2, all deviations of positive probability to first order are generated by x-y<(t-2)z (adds two sides) or y-z< (t-2)x (removes two sides), and other exceptional cones have spherical measure O((t-2)^2). The ordered octant occupies 1/48 of the sphere and spherical tie-band integration gives 2sqrt3/pi, (6-2sqrt3)/pi, 4sqrt3/pi and (6sqrt2-4sqrt3)/pi. Original facet test and independent finite implementation exercise cases; experiments do not substitute for proof.
